notes.title: Dark Gaia Studios' "Derange" comes to Steam!
notes.notes:
The spiritual successor to Dark Gaia Studios' classic horror series is finally here! [b][i]Derange[/i][/b], a terrifying new title from the creator of the [i]One Night[/i] trilogy has come to Steam. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31934265/c7eb2ffbe4bc20694f50c779834f9000839193c1.png[/img]
May 2nd, 2002. A mysterious email from a long-lost mentor sends you traveling to an isolated Gothic estate in the primeval wilderness of rural Massachusetts. When you arrive, you find yourself dragged into a nightmare beyond comprehension, hunted by eldritch foes and forced to fight for survival in the aftermath of a terrible fate.

[i][b]Derange[/b][/i] is a retro-styled spiritual successor to the survival horror classics of the '90s. Immerse yourself in gameplay from a forgotten era of horror as you struggle to unravel a terrifying mystery and put an end to an evil that threatens existence itself.

Do you have what it takes to survive this horrifying new adventure?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31934265/14c58846ad363d5c94244d609ba2be4f56433523.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1221230/Derange/]Buy Derange on Steam![/url]

notes.title: One Night 2: The Beyond is now on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h1]The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear.[/h1]

Hello survivors.

The latest horror adventure from Dark Gaia Studios is now available to purchase on Steam. [i]One Night 2: The Beyond[/i] is a classic Lovecraftian survival horror game that served as the original inspiration for [i]Mythos: The Beginning[/i], and players who loved the mysterious, subtly oppressive atmosphere of [i]Mythos[/i] will feel right at home.

The Steam version of [i]One Night 2[/i] is greatly enhanced over the original release, featuring engine updates, rewritten dialogue, brand new rooms and areas, overhauled gameplay mechanics and much more. Experience the nightmare today, and help support future horror projects from Dark Gaia Studios.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/960200/One_Night_2_The_Beyond/]One Night 2: The Beyond on Steam[/url]

notes.title: New patch (25/9/2018) is now online!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors.

I've just uploaded a small patch fixing a couple of minor bugs that (surprisingly) have been unreported since launch.

This update fixes the following issues:
[list][*]Crates no longer block the way to the Medical Room once you obtain the Drug Locker Key.
[*]The ending message will now correctly display whether you saved Tiffany or Alex.[/list]
